in_greek.name: Ἰησουᾶς

in_latin.name: Ioshuah

The name Joshuah symbolizes divine salvation and protection, reflecting God's power to save and deliver His people. Throughout Christian tradition, the name Joshuah has been associated with courage, leadership, and faith.

data.cultural_impact: The name Joshua holds a significant cultural impact in both the Jewish and Christian traditions. In the Jewish tradition, Joshua is revered as a great military and religious leader. He played a pivotal role in leading the Israelites across the Jordan River and into the Promised Land after the Exodus from Egypt. In the Christian tradition, Joshua is recognized as a type of Christ, as he led the Israelites on a spiritual journey towards the fulfillment of God's promise.
